- REQ-ERROR-SPECIFIC: - Each rule’s message clearly states what is wrong: - Missing @story/@req, invalid format, missing file, invalid path, missing requirement ID. - Tests verify messageIds and data payloads precisely, ensuring specificity.
- REQ-ERROR-LOCATION: - All rules report against specific AST nodes (function declarations, branch nodes, comment nodes), which is how ESLint encodes line/column. - For functions, require-req-annotation and require-story-annotation include function names in error.data, and tests assert data.name/functionName are correctly set.

- REQ-ERROR-CONSISTENCY: - Message conventions from the story are consistently implemented: - Function errors: templates reference '{{name}}' or '{{functionName}}'. - Branch errors: "Branch is missing required annotation: {{missing}}." - Format errors: "Invalid annotation format: {{details}}." - File errors: fileMissing/invalidExtension/invalidPath with '{{path}}'. - Requirement reference errors: reqMissing/invalidPath with '{{reqId}}' and '{{storyPath}}'. - JSDoc annotations across all rule files reference REQ-ERROR-CONSISTENCY and this story, showing intentional conformance.
